verdict.rationale: Tavily has a dedicated rate-limits page with per-environment RPM caps (Development 100, Production 1,000) and documents 429 responses that carry a `retry-after` header. Its pricing page shows a no-card free tier of 1,000 credits/month and pay-as-you-go billing, which implies but does not explicitly document a self-serve upgrade path. missing for 10: documented concurrency caps (distinct from RPM), an explicit self-serve upgrade flow from Development to Production limits, and independent corroboration of the limits in practice.
